Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for starting the onboarding conversation. Procurement needs a few canonical items to create a vendor master record so we can route POs and invoices correctly. Please reply with the items below or attach the files where indicated:

Required:
- Legal company name (as registered / tax filing name)
- Any DBAs (doing-business-as)
- Registered / legal address (street, city, state/province, postal code, country)
- Tax identifier (EIN / VAT / GST number) and which jurisdiction it applies to
- Completed W-9 (US) or W-8BEN-E (non-US) as applicable (PDF preferred)
- Primary AP invoice email and phone (we send PO/invoice notifications there)
- Remit-to address (if different from registered address)
- Bank details for ACH (bank name, account last 4, routing) or wire instructions (PDF or spreadsheet OK)

Optional but helpful:
- Company website and a short description of goods/services you supply to us
- Sales tax exemption certificates (if applicable)

We also need to confirm: do you require PO numbers on invoices to process? What are your standard payment terms (Net30, Net45, etc.)?

If you can get back to us by EOD Tuesday (2029-06-18) we can lock your vendor profile in time for the next purchasing wave.

Attachments: none in this message — please attach W-9/W-8 and remit sheet in your reply.

Thanks,

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Sanjay — really helpful. A couple of clarifications before I create the master record:

1) Remit-to confirmation: You listed the Harborview address as remit-to and registered address. For our ERP we prefer a physical remit-to address (PO Box is okay but we need the legal remittance location on file). Confirmed that the Harborview address is the correct remit-to?

2) Bank routing: The remit sheet has wire details — can you confirm the ACH routing number (full routing) to make ACH setup smoother? If you prefer not to send full account numbers via email, a secure upload link is fine — say the same Drive link or we can provide an SFTP.

3) Tax forms: The W-9 attached looks complete but the signature page is a scan dated 05/2029 — can you confirm signatory name and title match the EIN filing? We need signatory for vendor file provenance (name/title).

4) Invoice PDF format: To avoid delays, please confirm the invoice PDF includes an AP email and a clear total and invoice date — we will ask our AP team to approve format if necessary.

If you confirm the ACH routing and signatory name, I’ll create the vendor in the ERP and send back the vendor code / effective date.

Thanks,
